meta.name: ship
meta.description: Prepare or execute an authorized controlled release with verified checks, recovery and an operating owner. Use when a customer increment is ready for deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把待发布的功能增量做成一次有检查、有兜底、有人负责的正式上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都怕漏检查、出事又没法快速回退
copy.fit_line_en: For you if every release risks missed checks or no way back

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先读任务上下文契约与方法文档，再按授权范围准备或执行一次受控发布，产出已验证的检查项、回滚方案和运营负责人。缺能力或未跑的检查会如实报告，不声称装技能就等于有了基础设施。
howto.when: 当某个面向客户的增量已就绪、可以部署时触发。若由 @fde 调用，则沿用其当前已脱敏的数据包与范围，不重跑设置、发现或已答过的问题。

say.text: 这个客户增量可以发了，帮我准备一次受控发布
say.note: 会先读上下文契约和方法文档

say.text: 发布前列出已验证的检查和回滚方案
say.note: 会区分实现、验证、部署与验收

say.text: @fde 刚给过脱敏数据包，直接按这个范围执行发布
say.note: 复用现有范围，不重新初始化

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the task context contract and the method doc, then prepares or runs one authorized controlled release with verified checks, recovery and an operating owner. It reports missing capabilities or unrun checks honestly, and does not claim a skill provisions infrastructure.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a customer increment is ready for deployment. If called by @fde, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup, discovery or questions already answered.

say_en.text: This customer increment is ready, prepare a controlled release
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: List the verified checks and recovery plan before release
@fde just sent the sanitized packet, ship within that scope
say_en.note: Reuses the existing scope, no re-initialization
